soundness_flags.label: ass:radius
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited source uses a generic positive Besov-ball radius L>0; it does not support the tagged “standard” L≥10 normalization, which should be retagged as a benchmark convention or weakened.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:sharp-frontier / ass:known-uniform-design
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The covariate law is assumed known and uniform rather than estimated.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any completed frontier is for the stated known-uniform-design class only, not an unknown-design or general DoubleGen frontier.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines its positive-density Besov class for m,L>0 and gives the direct-sample Wp rate n^{-(1+s)/(d+2s)} for d≥3; it contains no L≥10 normalization premise.

source_verification_receipts.locator: PDF p. 4, equation (3); p. 6, equation (6); p. 13, Theorem 1 and equation (17); p. 17, Theorem 3

source_verification_receipts.locator: PDF p. 5, Definition 1 and equations (1)–(2); p. 9, Theorems 2–3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Extended W1 is exactly the conditioning-design average of statewise outcome W1; Theorem 2 has an implementation-transfer condition and logarithmic factor, while Theorem 3 supplies the continuous-conditioning lower bound.

Theorem 2 transfers an oracle generative minimax lower bound to the factual problem; Theorem 3 gives a diffusion total-variation bound with nuisance-error terms and the paper explicitly leaves a matching lower bound for its more restrictive upper-bound class open.
